businessContact.verification: Both addresses are published in plaintext on SoundChat Radio's official Contact page. Their stated general-office purposes were preserved. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed. The dedicated form remains the only authorized music-submission route.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The form requires creative selection, factual metadata, a rights-bearing broadcast authorization and a final inspection for any current hidden anti-spam, session or consent control.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: listener request telephone and WhatsApp routes

activityVerification.evidence: The official homepage exposed live listening and watching, current featured rotation and a first-party article dated March 16, 2026. The official schedule contained populated daily and weekly programming including reggae, dancehall and Caribbean shows.

genreFitEvidence: SoundChat Radio identifies reggae, dancehall and soca among its core music formats.
Its official schedule includes island, reggae, dancehall and sound-system programming.
Selected MarcsMusic reggae, electronic-reggae, dancehall-adjacent or world-fusion material has strong plausible fit after human track review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The first-party form is active and free, but it requires a selected track link, accurate artist information and an ownership and broadcast-rights affirmation. International eligibility, release timing, AI-origin policy and parts of the delivery specification remain unresolved. Human review and manual form completion are required.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete accessible pull-request patch was searched for the station name, domain, canonical submission path and both public business addresses; no existing music-submission-agent record was found before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The dedicated form is stored once as the canonical submission opportunity. General office emails, the general contact form, listener request lines, advertising, airtime, donation, shop and social routes are excluded.

notes: One new SoundChat Radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form or communication action was performed.
